en.headline: Asian Games athletes to join Sha Tin bus parade next Tuesday
en.dek: Gold medallists in rowing and windsurfing are among those who will meet residents during an open-top bus tour organised by the Sha Tin District Office and Festival Committee.
body: Several Hong Kong athletes who competed at the Asian Games in Nagoya will take part in a bus parade in Sha Tin next Tuesday to meet members of the public.

Those attending include rowing gold medallist Chiu Hin-chun and windsurfing gold medallist Wong Tsz-ho, along with silver medallists Hung Wing-yan, Leung Wing-nga and Cheung Yuen-shan in rowing, windsurfer Ma Kwan-ching and squash player Ho Tze-lok.

The athletes will attend a launch ceremony at the plaza of Sha Tin Town Hall at 4 p.m. before boarding an open-top bus. The route will pass outside Tai Wai MTR Station, Shek Mun Kings Wing Plaza and Chung On Shopping Centre. The Home Affairs Department said the event is co-organised by the Sha Tin Festival Committee and the Sha Tin District Office, and souvenirs will also be distributed to the public.

zh.headline: 亞運港隊運動員下周二參與沙田巴士巡遊與市民見面
zh.dek: 賽艇金牌趙顯臻、滑浪風帆金牌黃梓豪等將出席，巡遊由沙田節委員會與沙田民政處合辦，當日亦派發紀念品。
body: 多名出戰名古屋亞運的港隊運動員，將於下星期二出席沙田區舉辦的巴士巡遊，與市民見面。
出席的運動員包括賽艇金牌得主趙顯臻、滑浪風帆金牌得主黃梓豪，以及賽艇銀牌得主洪詠甄、梁穎桉及張莖珊、滑浪風帆代表馬君正、壁球代表何子樂等。
運動員當日下午4時會先到沙田大會堂廣場出席啟動儀式，其後登上開蓬巴士。巡遊路線包括大圍港鐵站外、石門京瑞廣場、頌安商場等。民政事務總署表示，今次巡遊由沙田節委員會與沙田民政處合辦，當日亦會向市民派發紀念品。
